case_title: MOHD. RAFIQ @ KALLU v. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH
offence_finally_established: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
neutral_facts: The accused was driving a truck when a police officer attempted to board it. The accused refused to stop, and the officer fell off the truck. The truck continued moving, and the officer was run over by the rear wheels, resulting in his death. The accused fled the scene but was later arrested. The prosecution alleged that the accused pushed the officer off the truck and intentionally ran over him. The trial court convicted the accused of murder, but the High Court and Supreme Court found that the accused did not have the intention to kill. The Supreme Court modified the conviction to culpable homicide not amounting to murder and sentenced the accused to 10 years of rigorous imprisonment.
